defs.meaning: 弗朗西斯（男子名，义为自由之人）

examples.en: "Give me a whisky," Debilly said to Francis. "Make it a double."
examples.zh: “给我来杯威士忌，”德比利对弗朗西斯说。“要双份的。”

examples.en: Francis felt he would like to stop this conversation in its tracks.
examples.zh: 弗朗西斯觉得他想中断这次谈话。

examples.en: Carl had asked him to visit the hospital and to pay his respects to Francis.
examples.zh: 卡尔已要求他去那所医院向弗朗西斯表示他的敬意。
